name: headless-app-tanstack
title: Headless App for TanStack Start
description: A backend your customers can use through their agents: sign-in, OAuth consent, an MCP server, and connected agent management.
docs: Set `site_url` and `additional_redirect_urls` in `supabase/config.toml` to your app origin, and use asymmetric JWT signing keys (ES256 or RS256). Set `PRODUCT_NAME` in `routes/_protected/agents.tsx` and `productName` in `routes/oauth/consent.tsx`. Start the local stack, generate the initial migration with `supabase db diff -f create_tasks`, review it, and apply it with `supabase migration up`. Copy `supabase/functions/mcp-server/.env.example` to `supabase/functions/.env` and run `deno task check` from the function directory before serving it. Add tools in `supabase/functions/mcp-server/tools/`, then sign in and open `/agents` to connect an agent. Before deploying, configure your production Auth URLs and email confirmations; see https://supabase.com/library/docs/tanstack/headless-app for the full setup.
